name: Report what admitting a submission found
description:
FACTS, NEVER A VERDICT. The runner sends Orion's admission record from its own node (`admission`: state, stage, reason), the stats Orion measured (`stats`) and its tally of the probe over the reference observations (`probe`), and this route stores them as they came. The admit clock reads them through admission_facts(), which types every value, and decides; a runner's role can write this row's report and nothing on model_versions.

FENCED ON THE CLAIM TOKEN, and idempotent under a duplicate delivery the way finish is: the route writes, then reads back. Reported and still mine is 200 {applied: false} -- a runner that reported, lost the response and retried did nothing wrong. Anything else is 409 claim_lost: the lease lapsed and another runner holds the row, the submission was decided or expired meanwhile, or the runner was revoked. A report after the lease lapsed is still taken while nobody else has claimed the row: the work is as good as it was.

tasks.name: Store the report under the claim
Diagnose what the row says now

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('mine', a.claim_token = ($2)::uuid, 'reported', a.report IS NOT NULL) AS body FROM admissions a WHERE a.version_id = ($1)::uuid

with.name: The claim really is gone
with.description: Reached when the row is not reported under this token: a lapsed lease another runner took, a submission decided or expired meanwhile, a revoked runner.
